name: A competitor's public page
description: One person's versions, GROUPED BY GAME AND SEASON, newest season first: someone who entered two seasons of one game has two standings, not one. PUBLIC, AND RETURNS ONLY WHAT IS PUBLIC -- `active` and `superseded`. A candidate mid-trial is a version nobody else may know exists and a rejection is nobody else's business, so the owner's own view is this response merged with GET /v1/models and GET /v1/me/matches rather than this route returning more to some callers.
